 With the international break now in hindsight, the table now spins towards the German Bundesliga, the Norwegian Eliteserien and the Roshn Saudi Pro League. Bayern Munich receives hostilities fromFC Cologne, Molde welcomes league giants Bodoe/Glimt and finally, Al-Ahli trade blows with Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al-Nassr.

 Get Your Registration Bonus! Bayern Munich vs FC Cologne
 League action gradually resumes as the weekend sets in with Bayern Munich launching drama as they face FC Koln in the tenth round of the prestigious Bundesliga. Die Bayern holds dominance in the last ten clashes against Koln with eight wins, one stalemate and one loss.
 Contesting the top of the league with Borussia Dortmund on twenty one points each, Bayern Munich have had quite the season — with six wins and three stalemates. In truth, they have been very unpredictable, winning out rightly in some matches and getting scared by extra time in others. Still, they remain the most clinical side with twenty-nine goals scored and nine goals conceded (second best after Dortmund — 7).
 Koln has lost control of the season early, with just two wins, three stalemates and four losses. Currently, they are two points above danger level and are considered lean underdogs against the opposing Bayern colossus. Holding consecutive stalemates against Schalke 04 (0-0) and Union Berlin (1-1), they fell to Bayer Leverkusen in the round before the break, making a comeback here very necessary for team momentum and morale.
 Bayern Munich will beat FC Koln and I am confidently predicting a minimum of four goals between the sides.
 Prediction: TO3.5 Goals 
 FK Molde vs Bodoe/Glimt
 The Eliteserien returns with Bodoe Glimt travelling to the Aker Stadion as they resume league action in Round 27. Bodø shares the lead with Vikings FK on sixty-two points each after twenty six rounds with twenty wins, two stalemates and four losses. With less than four matches to go, tension is high in the league and every point won— or lost could determine who takes the league silverware.
 Molde contends the fifth league spot slightly outside the Conference League qualification spots with one point as they come into this game. Earlier in the league, they enjoyed a 1-0 win against Bodoe at home — which was repaid in the Club Friendlies when they played a five-goal thriller against Bodoe Glimt, scoring only once.
 I’m betting on an outright win for Bodoe/Glimt, who are highly motivated due to Vikings’ hot chase for the league spot. Unless things go extremely wrong, an away victory is a very juicy and confident pick.
 Prediction: W2 
 Al-Ahli vs Al-Nassr
 Ivan Toney and Cristiano Ronaldo headline this Saudi Clasico as two of the best teams in the Roshn Saudi Pro League clash in a previously postponed Round 9 fixture. While Al Nassr has led the head-to-head (6-2-2), the two sides are currently firing hot, with twenty-eight goals scored each in the league.
 Typically, their meetings are always very physical, with cards flying frequently. However, the goal-scoring option for Al Nassr has been tested in their meetings, with two goals consistently scored in their most recent two clashes.. The 6-1 loss to Al Shabab recently has welded the winning confidence in the side of punters.
 The Total Over 2.5 goals seems uninteresting, and while Al-Ahli will be eager to redeem themselves in front of the domestic fans, Al Nassr’s flying form in their last fifteen matches (where they only have two losses across the board) makes them the best bet for this match — in terms of goal scoring.
 As such, I’m betting on at least four total goals here.
 Pick: TO 3.5
